evidenceKind: Deterministic current-source control-flow proof, not an executed CLI/crawler replay. No Cargo/build/upstream execution/new acquisition.
scope: Only the four retained F1 scalar withdrawals; shared Rust/index untouched.

trace: Root go.mod has module declaration; infer_go_module_commands emits build/test defaults.
Root README has no build/test declaration. Batch scripts are not command sources.
Workflow has cd v2 and cd gen/v2; infer_workflow_commands returnsNone for wholefile.
Fallback EcosystemDefault remains selectable; build selection written into freshmanifest.
predictions.limitation: A root-module build may work. This is an unsupported repository-default claim, not evidence the build command necessarily fails.

trace: Same root-module fallback after wholefile workflow refusal.
Separate retained v2/go.mod and gen/v2/go.mod plus CI module jobs establish additional owned scopes.
A root-module wildcard does not represent the separately declared module jobs; no aggregate default is established.
predictions.limitation: Does not claim root v1 tests are invalid or fail after preparation.

trace: Root go.mod emits generic build default.
README declares go get installation only; no source-owned build default.
Release-build workflow is ignored by specialized filename rule; no competing scalar build.
predictions.limitation: Redis test setup does not itself prove a Go build command incorrect. Narrow test-prerequisite fix alone does not address this build withdrawal.

trace: go-test workflow contains no cd/non-rootworking-directory; scalar workflow extractor accepts go test -race ./....
Setup-Redis action and matrix are not carried into ImportedCommandCandidate.
-race is not excluded by specialized-Go-workflow test filter.
Workflow selection invokes preferred_go_module_default_for_workflow_command; any flagged Go command is replaced with go.mod bare default.
Source scorer assigns medium inferred default, not high.
predictions.limitation: The tests can execute with Redis installed. The bare scalar loses required setup and the source race variant; this is not an observed test failure.

refreshPath.priorRecord: Both corrected records remain inferred overlays. Refresh refuses native/canonical/reviewed records, so these are eligible to be replanned.
refreshPath.newPlan: pipeline/mod.rs imports materialized sources afresh; previous_manifest is not passed to import_repository_with_options. It is used for authority refusal and record-level downgrade reporting.
refreshPath.evidence: retain_field_evidence reads any attachments only from the new import_plan.manifest, then replaces field_evidence with fresh scores/valueJson/source/time. It never receives the prior manifest.
refreshPath.status: Medium ecosystem-default fields block verified auto-promotion; they do not remove scalar values from a fresh import. This review does not assert a scheduled writeback actually occurred; scheduler/publication gates are outside this source-path proof.

existingNegativeEvidence.exists: The current records have exact field-level unresolved/null source_inspection assessments with sourceRevision, sourceSha256, reason and audit locator. Historical corrections.json preserves each old command and withdrawal disposition.
existingNegativeEvidence.notTombstone: There is no structured rejected candidate value/hash in these current field assessments, no enforceable per-value withdrawal ledger consumed by the importer, and no prior-field-evidence merge into new source plans. valueJson=null binds the absent value, not an arbitrary future rejected candidate.
existingNegativeEvidence.guardLimits: guard_against_unjustified_downgrade only reports changes when priorrecord was verified; it returns preserved=false and does not restore fields. Marking entire records reviewed/canonical would freeze unrelated fields and is not proposed.
existingNegativeEvidence.caution: Do not parse freeform reasons or audit-path prose as executable rejection policy, silently restore prior high assessments onto new values, or treat previous absence as permanent prohibition across source changes.

minimalProposal.goal: Prevent the known IBM build/test fallthrough without removing all Go metadata defaults.
minimalProposal.predicate: Retained source establishes multiple owned Go modules AND Go CI explicitly operates separate module directories; when that evidence makes root wildcard incomplete/aggregate default unresolved, suppress metadata-only Go scalar selection, retaining candidates and unresolved explanation. Do not trigger solely on a nested example module or unrelated cd.
pathsNeeded: crates/dotrepo-core/src/import/inputs.rs and types.rs only if bounded nested-module source paths must enter ImportSources
new import fixtures and coordinator-owned expectations.json
crates/dotrepo-crawler/src/github.rs only if bounded workflow-named Go module acquisition is chosen; separate network bounds/fixtures required
minimalProposal.scopeLimit: Exact source closure and candidate preservation need a separate implementation packet; do not infer complete context or high confidence.
minimalProposal.sourceAvailabilityGap: Current crawler supplemental roots include root go.mod but no nested-Go manifest discovery (github.rs26-66,791-825); ImportInputs also only loads root go.mod. Exact retained v2/gen module bytes are available for fixtures, not automatically available in a current crawler refresh. Any manifest-aware guard needs bounded source acquisition/ImportSources ownership or must retain uncertainty from workflow scope without claiming missing manifests inspected.

minimalProposal.predicate: The Go test-bearing job has external service/setup dependency (here the explicit Setup redis action/matrix); withhold scalar extraction AND metadata fallback for that test field. Preserve the observed flagged candidate as unqualified evidence rather than normalize away -race. Match job/step scope so unrelated lint/release setup cannot poison a plain test job.
pathsNeeded: new import fixtures and coordinator-owned expectations.json
minimalProposal.scopeLimit: This addresses test setup, not Redigo build. Preserving -race alone still leaves missing Redis prerequisites.

minimalProposal.part: Explicit durability decision for all four individual withdrawals
minimalProposal.goal: Prevent a known audited withdrawal being overwritten by the same conventional inference while retaining unrelated refreshable facts.
minimalProposal.predicate: If coordinator chooses durable negative assessments, bind field+rejected exact value+source closure/revision+assessment identity; consult it during fresh refresh before writing, and require explicit new source-grounded disposition to override. Existing unresolved/null metadata alone cannot identify this exact rejected candidate.
pathsNeeded: A separately owned private evidence contract/fixtures
crawler pipeline/evidence or a focused refresh guard
minimalProposal.scopeLimit: Proposal only; no new format is implemented here. Do not invent tombstones by parsing reason prose or silently reject all future values. Needed to cover Redigo build without overclaiming a test-prerequisite rule.

minimalProposal.goal: Consider whether go.mod alone should ever populate scalar defaults rather than only conventional candidates.
minimalProposal.scopeLimit: Globally skipping all Go EcosystemDefault scalars is a broader acceptance/coverage change. It is not the narrow approved fix, and requires frozen positive/negative fixtures plus review of existing expectations. Current test workflow_go_selectors_do_not_outrank_module_defaults deliberately locks existing normalization behavior.

notProposed: Execute upstream builds/tests or infer runtime failure.
Fetch new sources or modify the four index fields in this review.
Global blanket suppression from any workflow setup line or any nested module.
Promote inferred defaults to high confidence, or call correction durability consumer proof.
